meta.proposer: claude (mirrors s6e1/s4e1 protocol: propose-once / freeze / replay)
meta.strategy: The 37-member champion pool has NO shallow XGB and NO shallow CatBoost (both only depth 9-10); LGB already covers shallow. Inject bias-dominated shallow members of the under-represented families to maximize error-decorrelation of the variance-heavy deep pool (the archetype that took the largest LLM-member weight on s6e1 R2 and s4e1 AUC). All params are within the evaluator whitelist; AUC is rank-invariant so no is_unbalance weighting (INT-03/04).

proposals.expected: Solo AUC ~0.953-0.955 (below the deep members) but lowest error-correlation; realistic shot at nonzero blend weight.
proposals.rationale: Pool's only XGB is depth 9 (variance-dominated). A depth-3, strongly-regularized XGB is bias-dominated -- opposite error structure -> maximal decorrelation. This exact archetype took the largest LLM-member weight on s6e1 and s4e1.

proposals.expected: Solo AUC ~0.953-0.955; CatBoost's ordered boosting at shallow depth gives a differently-correlated error surface than the shallow XGB/LGB.
proposals.rationale: Pool's CatBoost is only depth 9-10. A depth-3, high-l2 CatBoost adds a second bias-dominated family, decorrelating from both the deep CAT and the shallow XGB above.

proposals.expected: Solo AUC ~0.951-0.954; an extreme-bias depth-2 stump-like learner, most decorrelated of the three.
proposals.rationale: Even though the pool has depth-3/4 LGB, a depth-2 num_leaves-4 LGB is more extreme-bias; a suboptimal-but-heterogeneous member is an asset for the blend (INT-04).
